biography.value:
EGLATH ASHLUNG — CR 1/8 goliath escaped mine-slave, near-noncombatant. Hauled the dead out of the shafts for Dhul Maldur. He is the one who wanted everyone freed; the column died for it and he lived. Guilt-eaten, begs the party to go back. Replaces Faelan Mirith as the Ashlands runner.

Rescue hook: he knows the holding pen — the rest of the column is at the staging mine near Dhul Maldur.

Manual — Powerful Build: counts as one size larger for carrying capacity.

Manual — Exhausted & starved: disadvantage on STR & CON checks and saves.

Manual — Won't fight (RP): runs, shoves, refuses to fight if he can run at all. Acts only if cornered or if someone else is about to die.

Manual — Hauler's Heave: the 10-ft push has no roll and no automation — move the target's token yourself.

abilities.name: Snapped Haul-Chain
abilities.desc: A length of mine chain still bolted to his wrist. Melee attack: 1d6+2 bludgeoning on a hit.
